packconverter.button.open: Pack Converter: convert and save old packs
packconverter.screen.title: Pack Converter
packconverter.screen.convert.tooltip: Saves a copy of the selected pack converted to 26.3. It works without this mod, in any client.
packconverter.screen.convert_all.tooltip: Converts every old pack in this folder and saves them in the export folder, one after the other. Press again to stop.
packconverter.screen.exists_all.title: Already converted
packconverter.screen.exists_all: %s of these %s packs are already in the export folder.
packconverter.screen.exists.title: Already converted
packconverter.screen.exists: %s is already in the export folder.
packconverter.info.not_yet: Converted for 26.3 the first time you apply it
packconverter.settings.title: Pack Converter Settings
packconverter.settings.auto.tooltip: Packs made for older versions are converted when you apply them (cached, so only the first time takes a moment). Off: they load as they are, like in vanilla.
packconverter.settings.folders.tooltip: Folders in the resource pack screen: packs in subfolders of resourcepacks are listed by folder, and the search looks through all of them. Nothing is written into your folders. Applies the next time the pack screen opens.
packconverter.settings.folders.lunar: Lunar Client has pack folders of its own: use Lunar's pack manager to sort your packs into folders.
packconverter.settings.previews.tooltip: Hovering a pack's name in the resource pack screen shows its HUD, crosshair, hit particles, items and a few blocks as they look in game (old packs converted).
packconverter.settings.details.tooltip: For checking a conversion: hovering an old pack in the resource pack screen also lists what it was made for and what was converted.
packconverter.settings.material.tooltip: Which material the pack previews show: every one the pack has, one after another, or just one.
packconverter.settings.netherite.tooltip: Old packs without netherite get netherite tools, armor items and worn armor recoloured from their own diamond ones. Shown at once in the packs in use.
packconverter.settings.netherite_color.t: The colour netherite is made in from diamond, with a preview.
packconverter.settings.knockback.tooltip: Diamond swords with Knockback II or more get a colour of their own: the pack's diamond sword, recoloured. In old packs (and the packs "Convert and save" makes, which do it without this mod too). Shown at once in the packs in use.
packconverter.settings.knockback_color.t: The colour of diamond swords with Knockback II, with a preview.
packconverter.knockback.title: Knockback sword colour
packconverter.settings.copper.tooltip: Old packs without copper get copper tools, armor items and worn armor recoloured from their own iron ones. Shown at once in the packs in use.
packconverter.settings.copper_color.tool: The colour copper is made in from iron, with a preview.
packconverter.copper.title: Copper colour
packconverter.netherite.title: Netherite colour
packconverter.netherite.ask.title: Netherite
packconverter.netherite.ask: %s has diamond items and armor but no netherite. Make netherite ones from the diamond ones?
packconverter.netherite.ask_all: %s of these %s packs have diamond items and armor but no netherite. Make netherite ones from their diamond ones?
packconverter.settings.clear.tooltip: Deletes every cached conversion that isn't in use. Packs are converted again the next time you apply them.
packconverter.settings.export.tooltip: Where "Convert and save" puts converted packs: a folder in the game folder, or a full path.
packconverter.settings.fast_reload.toolt: Switching packs doesn't cover the game with the loading screen: the menu stays on screen while the new packs load in the background, and they go in over a few frames instead of one long freeze. Shaders, fonts, sounds and languages are kept when the packs you changed have none. F3+T still reloads everything.
packconverter.settings.loading_bar.toolt: No progress bar at the bottom of the screen while packs switch (with Fast pack switching on). With RRLS (Remove Reloading Screen) installed, hides its bar too.
packconverter.settings.favourites.toolti: A star on each pack in the Resource Packs screen: starred packs stay at the top of the list, from any folder. From the next time the pack screen opens.
packconverter.settings.favourites.lunar: Lunar Client draws the pack list itself, so stars can't be shown there.
packconverter.settings.random.tooltip: A die button next to Done swaps your packs for a random one: from all packs, or only your favourites. Right-click it, or go to Controls, to give it a key (unbound at first; does nothing while this is off). From the next time the pack screen opens.
packconverter.random.info: Swaps your packs for a random one from the list.
packconverter.random.info_favourites: Swaps your packs for a random favourite from the list.
packconverter.random.binding: Press a key or mouse button (Esc: no key)
packconverter.random.none: There are no other packs to choose from.
